title: The Sunless Farms
kicker: A farming region shaped by canopy-darkness, local ingenuity, and crops that do not need corporate sunlight to grow.
hook: A farming region shaped by canopy-darkness, local ingenuity, and crops that do not need corporate sunlight to grow.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Sunless Farms grow under canopy-darkness, proving that lack of official sunlight never meant lack of life.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Crops grow here without the sun ever reaching them, pale rows lit by racks of living fungus-lamps tended like livestock. Compost pits breathe warmth up through the beds. The workers move by a careful schedule of light and heat, and they will tell you, with...
